fields.Name: Post Task Assignment to Teams
fields.Description: Posts a card naming a newly assigned task and its assignee to a Microsoft Teams channel. Set it as a Task Type's OnAssign action. The channel's webhook URL comes from a 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential: the one named in CredentialName, else the one named after the task type's Code, else the credential type's default. Accepts Office 365 connector and Power Automate Workflows webhook URLs.
fields.UserPrompt: Post a task assignment to a Teams channel.

fields.Name: TaskID
fields.Description: ID of the assigned task. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: TaskName
fields.Description: Name of the assigned task. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: TaskTypeID
fields.Description: ID of the task's type, used to find the credential named after its Code. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: AssigneePersonID
fields.Description: People record ID of the assignee. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: AssigneeName
fields.Description: Display name of the assignee, shown on the card. Passed by the OnAssign hook.

fields.Name: Status
fields.Description: Status of the task. Passed by the OnAssign hook; not used.

fields.Name: CredentialName
fields.Description: Name of the 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential to use. Optional; defaults to the task type's Code.
The card was posted.
TaskID or TaskName was not supplied.
TaskTypeID was supplied but is not a valid ID.
No 'Teams Channel Webhook' credential matched and the type has no default.
The credential's webhookUrl is not an https Teams connector or Power Automate webhook URL.
The webhook rejected the post or could not be reached.

fields.Name: Tasks: List Offboarding Holdings
fields.Description: Lists the open task assignments (Pending or In Progress, on tasks that are not Completed or Cancelled) held by a departed user, as their user, any Person bound to that user, or their employee record. Approval tasks are reported as APPROVAL_ASSIGNMENT, others as TASK_ASSIGNMENT. CanReassign on each item says whether the calling user may move it: the leaver's supervisor, a Sales Admin or a company's CFO approver may, and on approval tasks the Tasks ApprovalReassignRoles setting also applies. Run by the Offboarding screen.
fields.UserPrompt: List the open task assignments a departed user still holds.

fields.Name: LeaverUserID
fields.Description: MJ: Users ID of the person leaving. Give this, LeaverEmployeeID, or both; the other is found through the user's EmployeeID.

fields.Name: LeaverEmployeeID
fields.Description: MJ: Employees ID of the person leaving. Give this, LeaverUserID, or both.

fields.Name: Holdings
fields.Description: JSON array of holdings: App, Domain, Kind, KindLabel, EntityName, RecordID, Label (the task name), CanReassign, Note.
The holdings were listed (the list may be empty).
Neither LeaverUserID nor LeaverEmployeeID was given, valid, or matched a record.
No context user, or a lookup failed.

fields.Name: Tasks: Reassign Offboarding Holdings
fields.Description: Moves a departed user's open task assignments to a successor, in the same kind of record (user, Person or employee) the leaver was assigned through. Permission is checked again for every item. Each move saves the assignment as the calling user, so the approval reassignment guard runs: nobody may move an approval to themselves, and while ApprovalReassignRoles names roles only their holders may move approvals. A refused or impossible move is reported in Skipped. Who requested the task (AssignedByPersonID) and every completed or cancelled item are left as they are.
fields.UserPrompt: Move a departed user's open task assignments to a successor.

fields.Name: LeaverUserID
fields.Description: MJ: Users ID of the person leaving. Give this, LeaverEmployeeID, or both; the other is found through the user's EmployeeID.

fields.Name: LeaverEmployeeID
fields.Description: MJ: Employees ID of the person leaving. Give this, LeaverUserID, or both.

fields.Name: SuccessorUserID
fields.Description: MJ: Users ID of the active user who takes over the assignments.

fields.Name: Kinds
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of Kind codes (TASK_ASSIGNMENT, APPROVAL_ASSIGNMENT) to move; all kinds when omitted.

fields.Name: RecordIDs
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of Task Assignment IDs to move; all of the leaver's open assignments when omitted.

fields.Name: Moved
fields.Description: Number of assignments moved.

fields.Name: Skipped
fields.Description: JSON array of items not moved: Kind, EntityName, RecordID, Reason.
The permitted items were moved; any others are listed in Skipped.
The calling user may move none of the requested items.
The leaver did not resolve, Kinds or RecordIDs is not a JSON array of strings, or the successor is missing, inactive or the leaver.
No context user, or a lookup failed.
